beats.acting: Her greeting settles her attention on the unfamiliar man.
He answers courteously and fixes his attention on her.
Her direct question puts him briefly on the spot, and his nervousness becomes more visible.
Hearing that she has already heard of him makes him self-conscious; he briefly avoids her eyes.
The hesitation exposes his uncertainty as he searches for a safe answer.
She recognizes his discomfort and lightly needles him, without fully lowering her guard.
He gathers his thoughts, glancing upward as he searches for an explanation.
His unfinished explanation confirms that there is more behind his arrival, sharpening her attention.
Her correction is calm but quietly assertive, and her attention returns to the bird.
The correction gives him a concrete subject to follow, and he turns his attention to the hawk.
